notes.title: 🎉 Release Date & Price Announcement! 🔥
notes.content:
[h3]Elemental Rush launches on [b]July 18, 2025[/b]!
The full version will be available for [b]$8 USD[/b] [i](price may vary by region)[/i]. 💸[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657744/d9a74731580cbacce9a1cd9efe067bc829fd3c87.png"][/img][/p][p]🔥 Ready for a challenge? Try out the [b]free demo[/b] today and experience the elemental chaos!
💖 Don't forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] to stay updated![/p][p]🌪️💧🌿🔥 Let the elemental battle begin![/p]
